title: Descent of derived Hom between open strictly perfect stalks
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $x$ a point, and $U$ an affine open containing $x$. Let $P,Q$ be strictly perfect complexes on the localized module-sheaf site over $U$ [def-pc-perfect-complex]. Write $S_U$ for the open module stalk functor at $x$ [def-sc-open-module-stalk-functor]. Given an arrow $t:Q(S_U P)\to Q(S_U Q)$ in the derived category of modules over the stalk ring [def-pc-derived-category], there are an affine open $V$ containing $x$ with $V\subseteq U$, derived stalk isomorphisms $c_P:Q(S_V(P|_V))\cong Q(S_U P)$ and $c_Q:Q(S_V(Q|_V))\cong Q(S_U Q)$, and a derived arrow $g:Q(P|_V)\to Q(Q|_V)$ on $V$, whose image under the exact derived open stalk functor, conjugated by its localization factorization isomorphisms, is $c_P\circ t\circ c_Q^{-1}$ in diagrammatic order. No chain-map representative or global complex is part of this assertion.

source.place: Tag 09RE affine full faithfulness; More on Algebra Tag 0BC7 (2); Tags 00CR and 06Z0

proof.text: Apply the open stalk functor to the finite-free retractions of every term of P. Finite-free open stalks are projective by openModuleStalk_free_projective, so their retracts are projective. The upper support bound survives because the stalk functor preserves zero objects. CochainComplex.isKProjective_of_projective proves that the stalk complex of P is K-projective.

Apply the proved upstream CochainComplex.IsKProjective.exists_Q_map_eq from WeilConjectures.Mathlib.Algebra.Homology.DerivedCategory.KProjective to the K-projective stalk complex of P and t. It supplies a chain map f with Q.map f = t. This is the existing localization and homotopy-quotient surjectivity argument, not a new geometric result.

Apply exists_affine_perfect_open_stalk_chainMap_lift to f and the unchanged hypotheses on X, U, x, P and Q. It gives an affine V inside U containing x, a natural chain comparison e, and a chain map g between the restrictions, with S.map g = e_P.hom followed by f followed by e_Q.inv.

Take cP = Q.mapIso(e.app P), cQ = Q.mapIso(e.app Q), and the derived map Q.map g. Naturality of S.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom rewrites the derived image of Q.map g as Q.map(S.map g), after cancelling the factorization isomorphism. Substitute the lifted chain-map equality, distribute Q.map over composition, and use Q.map f = t. The resulting equality is precisely the required equation.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09RE affine case (1), bounded-projective chain representatives and finite-component descent; Tag 0BC7 (2). J2 uses the existing open-stalk chain-map lift and Mathlib K-projective localization, without affine derived equivalences or a derived Hom colimit presentation.

theorem exists_affine_perfect_open_stalk_derived_hom_descent
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    [∀ W : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over W))]
    (x : X) [HasDerivedCategory.{v} (ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.stalk x))]
    (U : X.Opens) (hxU : x ∈ U) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (P Q : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
    (hP : IsStrictlyPerfect X U P) (hQ : IsStrictlyPerfect X U Q)
    :
    let SU : SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U) ⥤
        ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.stalk x) := openModuleStalkFunctor X U ⟨x, hxU⟩
    letI : SU.PreservesZeroMorphisms :=
      AlgebraicGeometry.openModuleStalkFunctor_preservesZeroMorphisms X U ⟨x, hxU⟩
    ∀ t : DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((SU.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ⟶
      DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((SU.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q),
    ∃ (V : X.Opens) (hxV : x ∈ V) (_hV : IsAffineOpen V) (hVU : V ≤ U),
      let T := (SheafOfModules.overMap.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
        (homOfLE hVU : V ⟶ U)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
      let S : SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V) ⥤
          ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.stalk x) := openModuleStalkFunctor X V ⟨x, hxV⟩
      letI : S.PreservesZeroMorphisms :=
        AlgebraicGeometry.openModuleStalkFunctor_preservesZeroMorphisms X V ⟨x, hxV⟩
      letI : S.Additive :=
        AlgebraicGeometry.openModuleStalkFunctor_additive X V ⟨x, hxV⟩
      letI : PreservesFiniteLimits S :=
        AlgebraicGeometry.openModuleStalkFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits X V ⟨x, hxV⟩
      letI : PreservesFiniteColimits S :=
        AlgebraicGeometry.openModuleStalkFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits X V ⟨x, hxV⟩
      ∃ (cP : DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((S.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj (T.obj P)) ≅
          DerivedCategory.Q.obj
            ((SU.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P))
        (cQ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((S.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj (T.obj Q)) ≅
          DerivedCategory.Q.obj
            ((SU.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q))
        (g : DerivedCategory.Q.obj (T.obj P) ⟶ DerivedCategory.Q.obj (T.obj Q)),
        (S.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.app (T.obj P)).inv ≫
          S.mapDerivedCategory.map g ≫ (S.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.app (T.obj Q)).hom =
            cP.hom ≫ t ≫ cQ.inv
